name: Fairmont St. Andrews
positioning: Clifftop golf resort with two 18-hole courses, a spa and four-bedroom Manor Homes, on the coast east of St Andrews town center
best_for: Golfers who want a resort with two courses on site
Families and small groups who want a self-catering Manor Home

facts.text: The resort sits on the cliffs east of the town center of St Andrews and has two 18-hole golf courses.
The resort stands on a 520-acre estate with cliff-top views of the North Sea.
Dining includes La Cucina, serving relaxed Italian-style food, and the St Andrews Clubhouse and Grill, with panoramic coastal views.
Kittocks Bar and Zephyr Sports Bar suit family time, and Zephyr has a pool table and a sports simulator.
The Manor Homes are self-catering, with open-plan living, a farmhouse-style kitchen, a dining room and golf course views.
Rooms and suites use rustic earth tones with tartan accents and have sea and golf course views.
The resort runs an airport Meet and Greet service and private transfers and tours; transport requests need 24 hours' notice.

highlights.text: The Kingdom of Fife Suite is a one-bedroom king suite for families and friends, with a separate living and dining area and a private balcony.
The Fairmont Spa treatments use products from ESPA Skincare and the Hebridean brand ishga.
Dogs are welcome, and pets are allowed in the lobby, atrium and hallways and in certain pet-friendly rooms.
Golf lessons with a PGA professional are offered.

considerations.text: The resort is on the cliffs east of the town center, not in the center of St Andrews.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation to reach the town center.
Airport and private transfer requests need 24 hours' notice.
